slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Engineering Transformation
slides.n: Please welcome Mayur Saxena, a PMP-certified engineering leader with over two decades of experience building high-performing teams and delivering enterprise-scale products. {His} journey spans software development, testing, DevOps, and technology leadership, with a recent focus on driving Agentic AI transformation across engineering organizations.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, reduced upgrade time ~90%, drove security hardening, and led 7-8 agentic AI agents for CVE remediation and bug automation.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led Webex developer experience team, architected distributed Webex-Microsoft Teams presence/calling integration using Kafka, Redis and Java, and drove AI-based code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led developers, testers and release engineers on Cisco Expressway gateway, driving Python/C++ platform features, OS upgrades, and DevOps-based release infrastructure.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Owned functional, regression and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, handled customer escalations with SIP/H.323/RTP troubleshooting, and pushed automation coverage toward 100%.
Verizon & Alcatel India · 2007-2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow, regression and bug verification testing for IP contact center and Alcatel OmniPCX PBX solutions.
slides.n: {His} career shows a steady climb from hands-on QA and testing roles into technical leadership and engineering management. Along the way, {he} built deep expertise in VoIP systems, distributed architectures, DevOps, and most recently, agentic AI-driven engineering practices.

Over the years, {name} has developed a broad technical toolkit — from deep VoIP protocol expertise to modern cloud, DevOps, and generative AI capabilities. This blend allows {him} to lead both legacy platform modernization and cutting-edge AI adoption initiatives.

These numbers reflect the tangible impact {name} has delivered — from dramatically cutting upgrade times to resolving over a hundred long-standing defects and building a suite of AI agents that automate issue resolution and security remediation.

{His} formal education laid the engineering foundation, while {his} more recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence reflects {his} continued commitment to staying at the forefront of technology, complementing {his} PMP-certified leadership background.

That concludes {name}'s professional journey — a story of steady growth from hands-on testing to engineering leadership, and now to pioneering agentic AI transformation. Thank you for your time, and {he} looks forward to connecting further.
